answers.core: This should definitely be core. Keystore and key management aren’t optional extras when developing for Android. They’re a fundamental part of signing and publishing apps. If I’m using Godot to export to Android, I expect the same baseline functionality and capabilities that Android Studio or other standard toolchains provide. Having this only as an add-on would create unnecessary friction for developers who just want to sign their apps properly.
answers.workaround: No, it can’t realistically be worked around with a script. Keystore handling is tied directly into the Android export pipeline, and developers can’t override that process from GDScript. Since exporting signed builds is a requirement for publishing on Google Play, this needs to be built into core rather than left to scripting hacks.

title: Android Export: Separate keystore and alias passwords
